BUY Decision Checklist · kairos.html Detail walk-through

screener says BUY → before you click "+ add position" · 10 tabs · ~7 minutes
A screener BUY is a candidate, not a trade. Every tab has its own Executive Brief at top (verdict + KPIs) and a The Call section at bottom. Read the brief first, drill into the specific concerns, read The Call last. If any tab's verdict pill is not BUY, you don't proceed — you either WATCH with a trigger or SKIP.
v2 · 2026-05-14 · aligned with current kairos.html SUB_TABS (round 4)   Tab names, kbd shortcuts, and section IDs verified against renderValueTab / renderRiskTab / renderEarningsTab / renderPortfolioTab / renderEdgeTab as of this commit.
9–10 GREEN
FULL SIZE
T1 conviction · 5–10% equity · all lenses agree, no material red flag
7–8 GREEN
HALF SIZE
T2 conviction · 2–4% equity · ≤ 2 amber, no red. Tighten stop or trim T1 earlier.
5–6 GREEN
WATCH
Set price alert at entry-zone low. Document specific trigger. NO position.
≤ 4 GREEN · ANY RED
SKIP
Move on. Forced trades = drawdown trades.
Order: 1 Overview→ 2 Plan · Ticket→ 3 Technicals→ V Value→ R Risk→ E Earnings→ O Options→ P Portfolio→ I Tape · Flow→ 7 Track Record
1 Overview "Should I look closer? · master verdict + Rule Engine + Macro drill-downs" Hedge-fund analyst
Composed of Pre-Mortem · OverviewV2 · Rule Engine · Macro. The single-pane summary — if it fails here, no other tab saves it.
Read first: Executive Brief verdict pill + 5 KPIs at top of tab.
#FieldPassWhy
1
Exec Brief
Verdict pill
large arc + verdict string
 BUY Aggregate of 5 pillars + gates. Anything other than BUY = do not proceed.
2
Exec Brief
Composite score
central arc 0-100
 ≥ 65 risk-on · ≥ 72 choppy · ≥ 78 risk-off Regime-conditional floor. Below = pipeline-blocked.
3
Pre-Mortem
"What would make this wrong"
violet-bordered card near top
 3+ specific invalidation conditions If you can't articulate why it could fail, you don't understand the trade.
4
OverviewV2
Conviction tier + setup family
below arc
 T1 or T2 · named setup (VCP, PEAD, Pullback) T1=full · T2=half · T3=monitor · WATCH=zero. Generic momentum without setup family is lower edge.
5
Rule Engine
Gate cascade
"Rule Engine" drill-down · expand
 All hard gates PASS · 0 fails Earnings_clear · regime_allows · entry_quality · liquidity. Any fail = AVOID.
6
Macro
Regime classification
Macro drill-down · regime banner
 risk_on_trending or risk_on_choppy · NOT panic Regime is the most important code in the system. Misclassifying = every other rule wrong half the time.

Overview red flags

  • Verdict WATCH / AVOID / SHORT · screener disagreement with deeper pipeline · trust the deeper.
  • Score < regime floor · pre-blocked.
  • Regime = PANIC · no longs, period.
  • Rule Engine shows rejection reasons · concerns even if not blocking.
2 Plan · Ticket "Execution-ready ticket · entry/stop/size/pre-mortem/order" CFP / portfolio manager
The execution cockpit. Before clicking "+ add position", every number here must make sense. Risk before targets — if you can't articulate the stop in dollars, you don't take the trade.
Read first: Executive Brief at top of Plan tab.
#FieldPassWhy
1
Entry zone
"Entry $X.XX – $Y.YY"
 Within 0.75–1.25 ATR of pivot FRESH/PULLBACK quality. > 2 ATR = chasing.
2
Stop · close-based
red STOP tile · "1.25× ATR"
 ≤ 8% of price · close-based Mechanical stop. Close-based survives noise wicks.
3
R-multiple T1 / T2
"R = X.X" sub-line
 T1 ≥ 2R · T2 ≥ 3R Industry standard 3:1 minimum. Below = math doesn't work.
4
Kelly-lite sizing
"Size · X.X% equity"
 ≥ 4% for T1 · ≥ 2% for T2 Below 1% = system finds no edge. Skip.
5
$ risk per share + total $
Risk tile
 Total $-risk ≤ 1% of account Single-trade ruin rule. 1% × 50 trades = survivable drawdown.
6
Hold window
"Max hold: X days"
 5–21 days · matches setup family Impulse 5-8d · Breakout/VCP 7-21d · Pullback 5-14d.
7
Pre-mortem invalidation
"What invalidates" list
 3+ specific conditions Pre-named exits prevent emotional override.
8
Order ladder
"Order sequence" 6-step
 Limit-buy + GTC stop + GTC T1 all defined No market orders. Pre-place all three.

Plan red flags

  • R:R < 3 · math doesn't work.
  • Stop > 8% from entry · sizing collapses; not worth screen time.
  • Kelly final < 1% · no edge.
  • No pre-mortem populated · trading on hope, not system.

Composite tab — switch between Standard (rich price ladder + indicator toggle panel · 50+ overlays), Patterns (Wyckoff · Classical · Volume Profile · Fib · Ichimoku · EW), and SMC (Order Blocks · FVG · Liquidity). Use the segmented control at the top to switch views.

#FieldPassWhy
1
Standard view
EMA stack
price ladder · enable 8/13/20/50/100/200 toggles
 EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA50 > EMA200 · price above all Bullish trend stack. Inversion (EMA50 < EMA200) = weakening.
2
Standard view
RVOL (relative volume)
Volume bars · RVOL label
 ≥ 1.5× on breakout candles Without volume, breakouts fail. 2× = institutional.
3
Standard view
RSI(14)
enable oscillator pane
 50–75 momentum zone < 50 = no momentum · > 80 = exhausted.
4
Standard view
ADX(14)
enable ADX in panel
 ≥ 25 · trending < 20 = chop · breakouts fail.
5
Patterns view
Wyckoff phase
switch to Patterns · phase bar
 Phase D markup or trend-continuation Phase A/B = too early · Distribution = no longs.
6
Patterns view
Ichimoku 5-signal
Ichimoku section · 4 tiles
 5/5 bullish: above cloud · TK cross · Chikou clear · future cloud green Triple-bull alignment. Mixed = wait.
7
Patterns view
Fib 0.618 hold
Fib section · status tile
 ABOVE GOLDEN 0.618 is the bull-line. Break = structural change.
8
SMC view
Order Blocks · bullish demand
switch to SMC · OB grid
 Bullish OB below price · unmitigated bearish OB above = caution Demand floor below · supply ceiling above.
9
SMC view
Volume Profile POC
Volume Profile right-edge histogram
 Price > POC · accepted above auction POC = magnet. Price above on RVOL = institutional acceptance.

Technicals red flags

  • Price below EMA50 daily · trend not intact.
  • RVOL < 1.0 on breakout · fake breakout odds high.
  • Wyckoff distribution phase or SMC bearish unmitigated OB overhead.
  • Patterns conviction LOW · 6 methods disagree.

The Call
Value lens verdict
bottom of tab
 BUY or WATCH with trigger Value lens's independent call. Disagree with screener = read why.

Value red flags

  • MoS negative · price above DCF max scenario.
  • ROIC < WACC for 4+ quarters · value-destroying.
  • Thesis Killer firing · disruption / margin / regulatory.
  • Quality grade D/F · junk-quality.

The Call
Risk lens verdict
bottom of tab

Risk red flags

  • CVaR 99% 5d < −20% · tail loss un-survivable for normal sizing.
  • Max DD 3y < −50% · high-beta name needs DD multiplier kick-in.
  • Position > 1% of ADV · liquidity-constrained.
  • Calmar < 0.3 · pain-to-return ratio broken.

1
Trading Rules
ER blackout state
red/green banner at top

2

Days to next earnings
"Days to ER" KPI
 > 14d for clean swing entry Buffer between entry and announcement.
3

IM % · IM $
Implied Move panel
 ≤ stop distance If IM > stop, options expect you to stop 32% of the time.
4

Beat pattern
BMBM letter row
 ≥ 6 of 8 beats · median surprise positive PEAD-eligible. Mixed pattern = unreliable.
5
Revisions
EPS revisions 30d
net ↑ ↓ count

6

Last-quarter guide direction
Guidance summary

Historical post-print drift
drift chart 5d/10d/30d

8

sympathy table

9

Analyst-estimate spread
Dispersion bar

10
The Call
ER lens verdict
bottom of tab
 BUY · PEAD or WATCH Verdict depends on ER timing + ESP + revision direction.

Earnings red flags

  • ER blackout BLOCKED · swing entry disallowed by trading rules.
  • Revisions BEARISH · analysts cutting forecasts.
  • Guidance LOWERED last quarter.
  • Implied Move > stop distance · ER vol exceeds your risk budget.

Portfolio lens verdict
bottom of tab

Portfolio red flags

  • Avg correlation > 0.70 · stacking same factor exposure.
  • Cap usage > 100% post-trade · over-extended.
  • Sleep Test RED · size too large for tolerance.
  • Suitability mismatch · doesn't fit stated goal/horizon.

Track Record red flags

  • n < 10 in History view · too noisy.
  • Wilson LB < 40% · honest floor below break-even.
  • Any model votes SHORT · disagreement signal.
  • HMM in BEAR or PANIC · no longs.
  • Drift WATCH · edge eroding.

Final scoring matrix · 10 tabs → position size

tally green tabs · apply red-flag overrides · arrive at FULL / HALF / WATCH / SKIP
ResultGreen tabs (of 10)SizeConvictionAction
FULL SIZE 9 – 10 green · 0 red 5–10% equity T1 · high Place orders pre-market. Trail-stop activation at +2%. Trim ½ at T1, runner at T2.
HALF SIZE 7 – 8 green · ≤ 2 amber · 0 red 2–4% equity T2 · medium Tighten stop 1.0× ATR. Trim ⅔ at T1.
WATCH 5 – 6 green · critical ambers 0% WATCH Price alert at entry-zone low. Document SPECIFIC trigger (price · ER · regime flip). No trigger = no trade.
SKIP ≤ 4 green · ANY RED 0% not a candidate Move on. Forced trades are drawdown trades.

Master kill-switch · ANY = SKIP regardless of green tabs

  • Regime = PANIC (VIX > 35 · breadth < 20%) · no longs.
  • Earnings ER ≤ 14 days AND no specific ER thesis · blackout per Trading Rules.
  • Insider selling > $5M in 30 days.
  • Material negative headline in last 5 days.
  • Stop > 8% from entry · sizing forced too small.
  • Account drawdown > 10% · Kelly DD multiplier should kick in.
  • Risk lens CVaR 99% 5d < −20% · tail loss un-survivable.
  • You can't articulate the mechanism in one sentence · you don't understand the trade.
  • You feel rushed · FOMO is a loss signal.
⌗ Timing · how long this takes
Disciplined walk: 5–7 minutes across 10 tabs. Each tab's Executive Brief at top + The Call at bottom = 90 seconds per tab. Drill into sections only when Exec Brief shows amber/red.

Pre-market: finish by 9:25am ET so orders place before open. Mid-day entries: same 5–7 minute check. Never click "+ add position" without it.
